name: a Class and three aggregates: one request at the frame's end; each wired output, then Success
because: aggregatenode.js :74-78 the Class asks; :286-310 the group (avgPts with no Operation is avg, names is distinct); ParseWireAdapter.ts :405-449 the old spelling; :160-167

name: nothing wired out of it: Success alone
because: :163-164 an output is flagged only when a wire made it

name: dbVersionMajor 5: $match / $group, and _id in place of objectId
dbVersionMajor as the editor stores it, the text '5': the same spelling ('5' > 4)
because: schemahandler.ts :225-228 stores the major version as text; ParseWireAdapter.ts :431

name: a filter in the builder's saved shape with a static value: the request carries match=
the retired visual shape and its parameter: the filter reads the parameter by its bare name
because: :357-360 qp-min is kept as min; saved.ts :271 a visual rule's input

name: the builder's saved shape with a CONNECTED value: the condition is dropped and the whole class is aggregated (P107-S99-AGGFILTERPREFIX)
because: :180-183 passes no value-port prefix, so qp-min is looked up as qp-min among parameters kept as min; queryutils.ts :286 dropUnresolvedConnected

name: a filter parameter changes: the aggregation runs again
a filter that cannot be translated: Failure with the filter's own words, and no request
Do wired: a write asks for nothing; only Do does, once per frame however many presses
because: :77, :327, :332, :394 isInputConnected('storageFetch'); :362-371; :107-108; :394 a setting kept by name asks only when Do is not wired

name: Do unwired, pressed in a frame a write already asked in: still one request
an aggregate named with no Property written: nothing at all — no request, no Success, no Failure — and writing its Property later asks for nothing either (P107-S99-AGGNOPROP)
because: :297 defs[a].prop on undefined throws inside the frame-end callback, which swallows it; :334-346 a Property asks for nothing; then a Class write asks and the aggregation runs

name: a Property that is not a column of the class: that aggregate is left out of the request
an Operation the wire does not spell: that aggregate asks for {}
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :421-428 only avg, sum, max, min, distinct

name: the built-in backend's cached columns: no aggregate is asked for, and the one row is a Success that sends nothing (P107-S99-AGGCOLUMNS)
because: :290-292 reads schema.properties only; nodegx-backend byob-admin.ts getSchema caches columns

name: a Class the project does not have: no aggregate is asked for
a second Success with a new total: the output moves
an answer with no row after one with values: Success, and the outputs keep the last aggregation's values (P107-S99-AGGSTALE)
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :454-457 no row hands {}; :162-165 flags only the names the answer carried

name: an answer with two rows: Success, nothing sent
a 201 with one row: the same as a 200
a 400 that names its cause: Failure, and the server's words are lost (P107-S99-AGGWORDS)
a 500 with an HTML body: Failure
a 200 whose body is not JSON: Failure
a 200 whose body is JSON null: Failure
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :454 null.results throws in the chain; :345 its catch

name: a [null] row with aggregates asked: Failure
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :459-461 reads the row once per aggregate

name: a [null] row with none asked: Success
because: ParseWireAdapter.ts :459-461 an empty group never reads the row

name: the request never reaches the server: Failure
a Failure, then a Success: Error keeps the failure's sentence
no loopback and no project endpoint: Failure inside the frame, no request
no loopback: the project's own endpoint and app id, and no master key
the run's id on the loopback: X-NodeGX-Run
a slow answer and a second aggregation before it lands: each answer is told in turn
because: each request is its own fetch chain

name: no Class: nothing asks for an aggregation until a Class is written
a setting kept by name: an aggregation
an empty Aggregates list: no aggregate asked
